# mp4-muxer 5.2.2

Pinned, unmodified browser ESM bundle from the MIT-licensed npm release:

- Source: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mp4-muxer
- Module: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mp4-muxer@5.2.2/build/mp4-muxer.mjs
- License: `LICENSE` from the same npm release.
- Module SHA256: `d2c4c782f180c86ed30b1f5d9487a34a0d370bf9b4535285734ea187d38f9bb5`

Only local H.264 MP4 muxing is used. The library makes no network calls. This
upstream package is deprecated in favor of Mediabunny; it is pinned for the small,
established muxing API and is not used to decode files or contact external APIs.
